invariants.rationale: The method throws an exception if spaceTop is null, so this must always be non-null on method exit.
The method returns 'this', which cannot be null, so result is always non-null.
The return value is unconditionally 'this', so result must always be equal to 'this'.
The method sets this.spaceTop to the parameter, so after return, the spaceTop field of result equals the argument.
